recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-27040 unless a future CDS work-group decision revises the PlanDefinition.action.goalId example.
issue_request: FHIR-27040 is a Published/Persuasive CDS change request for FHIR-core PlanDefinition asking to add an example to the PlanDefinition.action.goalId definition. The accepted resolution was to add the suggested pharmaceutical-quality example: a Goal is equivalent to acceptance criteria for a given Action/Test, and the goalId is the unique identifier for that acceptance criterion.
initial_application: Jira comments point to HL7/fhir PR #1043 and PR #1134. Git commit 910a2256446d1b85ebcbbe618cbe3a4255ad05c0 explicitly includes J#27040 and added the requested pharmaceutical-quality wording to the then-authoritative source/plandefinition/plandefinition-spreadsheet.xml action.goalId definition.
additional_context: The source refactor in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 moved PlanDefinition into source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml while preserving the wording. PlanDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and corrected Zulip/Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope PlanDefinition source already includes the requested acceptance-criteria example for PlanDefinition.action.goalId; generated-looking SVG text also reflects it, but the authoritative StructureDefinition source is the relevant build input.
